phase.p2Body: run the test/lint/typecheck/scan rails, re-measure the engine state after the patch lands, and route the draft to the reviewer who can move fastest. convention conformance gates auto-submit but does not block the draft.
phase.p3Body: this is the policy layer. tune the thresholds that decide who ships without a human, see the rollback contract that arms before merge, and watch the dismiss feedback stream that reshapes future candidates.

empty.noCaseBody: pick a seed from the left sidebar to inspect the pipeline.
empty.trustNoCandidate: select a candidate to inspect its trust profile.

candidates.noViableBody: loop aborted before producing a deliverable patch. escalate to human checkpoint or enrich the seed and retry.
candidates.subtitle: choose one to draft

tier.explainSafe: eligible for one-click draft. mechanical patch class, blast ≤ 1, all proofs pass.
tier.explainGuarded: draft PR with explicit reviewer approve. proofs static-pass; dynamic bounded.
tier.explainHuman: route to manual review. exceeds delivery-gate thresholds or touches public surface.

confidence.strong: strong: proofs cover all paths the engine traced.
confidence.sound: sound: weakest obligation is bounded and addressable.
confidence.mixed: mixed: review the weakest link before merging.
confidence.weak: weak: not delivery-ready. consider seed enrichment.

trust.selectCandidate: select a candidate to inspect its trust profile.

draft.title: draft pr package
draft.abortedBody: loop aborted — no deliverable package. enrich seed evidence and retry, or escalate.
draft.pendingBody: package will assemble once a candidate clears its proof obligations.

reanalysis.title: post-patch re-analysis
reanalysis.subtitle: engine re-run · before → after
reanalysis.empty: re-analysis is empty — patch did not produce a deliverable to re-measure.

reviewer.title: reviewer routing
reviewer.subtitle: ranked by match × (1 − load)
reviewer.empty: no reviewer suggestion — ownership graph could not match.

convention.title: convention conformance
convention.subtitle: gates auto-submit only · does not block draft
convention.empty: no stylistic obligations attached to this candidate.

policy.title: policy thresholds
policy.subtitle: tune what qualifies for safe-mechanical
policy.footer: changes apply to future candidates · existing drafts re-gate on save

rollback.title: rollback package
rollback.subtitle: generated alongside draft · pre-armed
rollback.empty: no rollback plan — this case did not produce a deliverable.
rollback.armedHint: auto-revert hook is wired before the merge button is enabled.

dismissModal.title: dismiss candidate · log reason
dismissModal.feedbackHint: feedback feeds the next candidate generation. don't waste the dismiss.
dismissModal.notePlaceholder: what would make the next candidate more useful?
